title: Explain when an acknowledged next-turn source selection is discarded
outcome: When an acknowledged deferred selection cannot apply because its authority or root image changed, the session receives a clear diagnostic rather than silently opening on the previous claim.
acceptance: A behavioral test changes a deferred selection's previous binding or root image before its next opening; the invalid selection stays refused and a session notice explains why it did not apply.
A valid acknowledged selection still applies exactly once at the next eligible opening without extra warning or weakened authority guards.
